record.original_question: For odd-dimensional lens spaces of dimension 2n − 1 with fundamental group of order q, can there exist an isospectral non-isometric pair when n is congruent to −1 modulo φ(q)/2, where φ is Euler's totient function?

evidence.quote: Question 4.10. Are there isospectral and non-isometric (2n−1)-dimensional lens spaces with fundamental group of order q satisfying n ≡ −1 (mod ϕ(q)/2)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $q\ge 2$ be an integer and let $\varphi$ denote Euler's totient function. A $(2n-1)$-dimensional lens space with fundamental group of order $q$ is the quotient $L = S^{2n-1}/\Gamma$, where $S^{2n-1}\subset\mathbb{C}^n$ is the unit sphere and $\Gamma\cong\mathbb{Z}/q\mathbb{Z}$ acts freely on $S^{2n-1}$ by an isometry of the form $(z_1,\dots,z_n)\mapsto(\zeta^{s_1}z_1,\dots,\zeta^{s_n}z_n)$, where $\zeta = e^{2\pi i/q}$ and $s_1,\dots,s_n$ are integers coprime to $q$. Two such lens spaces are called isospectral if the spectra of their Laplace–Beltrami operators (acting on smooth functions, with multiplicities) coincide, and isometric if there is a Riemannian isometry between them.

Question: Suppose $n\equiv -1\pmod{\varphi(q)/2}$. Does there exist a pair of $(2n-1)$-dimensional lens spaces with fundamental group of order $q$ which are isospectral but not isometric?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem regarding a congruence obstruction to isospectrality for lens spaces. Classical work of Ikeda (1980) and subsequent papers construct isospectral non-isometric lens spaces in many dimensions, but none of the found references resolves the specific congruence case $n\equiv -1\pmod{\varphi(q)/2}$. No published resolution was located.

status_evidence.title: On lens spaces which are isospectral but not isometric (Ikeda)
status_evidence.snippet: Foundational construction of isospectral non-isometric lens spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Background on the isospectral-lens-space problem; does not address the n ≡ −1 (mod φ(q)/2) case.

status_evidence.title: Orbifold Lens Spaces that are Isospectral but not Isometric
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs isospectral non-isometric orbifold lens spaces under certain dimensional conditions.
status_evidence.claim: Related constructions exist but the specific congruence question is not resolved in these works.
